normal.coordinates: Simple cylindrical GeoTIFF centered at 0, left edge 180 E. Raster x increases eastward, while the map labels express west longitude. Roll half-width, do not mirror.

enhanced.coordinates: 0 E left edge, north up. Odysseus aligns around 230 E after rolling the monochrome map. No mirror.
enhanced.processing: Published radiometric calibration, geographic registration and photometric correction by Paul Schenk. Preserve residual image shading and resolution differences.

elevation.sourceUnits: Global GeoTIFFs: radius from center in meters. Regional products use a different height convention and are not used.
elevation.sampling: Use equatorial equirectangular grid from -55 to +55 degrees and source polar stereographic grids beyond. Never stretch equatorial pixels to the poles.
elevation.resolution: Approximately 1.5 km; 2222 x 679 equator, 444 x 444 each pole.
elevation.processing: Bilinear source sampling, northwest cartographic light, true height scale, shared Q90 display atlases.

shape.rendering: Shared spherical approximation uses the astronomy package and 2012 map reference radius. No displaced geometry. Keep distinct physical and cartographic reference values.
